A. Partitioning allocates some fraction of a clock cycle to different blocks and the top-level design for signals crossing block boundaries.
B. Budgeting divides a given top-level design into smaller parts called blocks.
C. Top-level assembly integrates all the blocks at the top level.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?

questions.html:
Consider the following statements about mesh grid topology in power planning:

A. Rails and straps are organized as a uniformly spaced array in a mesh grid topology.
B. The resistance from the power pad to any point in the grid is typically high because there is only one electrical path between them.
C. The robustness of the mesh grid topology is low because if any wire breaks, the only existing electrical path between the power pad and any point in the grid becomes an open circuit.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
